protocolNotes: Mapping rows are representative components. Complete-action calculation must compile an explicit fully observed event schedule; never sum one representative proc as the lifetime total.
All candidates, target eligibility, snapshots and passive already-included shares must be explicit; unknown dependencies stay blocked.
Character and enemy StatusIsActive uses inclusive expiry via modifier.FindCheckExpiry. Core.Status.Duration and AttackMods differ.
Minazuki state entry checks ICD; its recurring ticker deliberately does not. A rejected state entry does not replace tickSrc.
Fischl fresh E spawns at 18, first tick 64 after spawn, interval59; full unshortened Q spawns113, first tick69 after spawn, interval59. Oz status checks include the tick exactly at600.
Dehya reposition initial uses the prior field snapshot; the restored field takes a new snapshot at41 and preserves remaining cooldown with40-frame delay and remaining life plus24.
No automatic team rotation, aura, ICD, hitlag, collision, target-death transfer, recast/replacement, Hexerei or extra Fischl A4 triggers are certified.

Raiden Eye is an AttackMod: at expiry ApplyAttackMods purges it for ordinary attacks before damage events, but ordinary reactions bypass that cleanup; expiry-frame qualification requires source actor event order.
